claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this HRH1 antagonist most plausibly kills cells through a cationic amphiphilic drug-like lysosomal/physicochemical stress rather than through histamine receptor blockade, producing a broad but somewhat selective antiproliferative pattern.
